cases.task: Diagnose weak newsletter acquisition. The supplied audit shows that posts containing links rose from 35% to 80%. A launch retrospective says its registration form became available after peak traffic. No lost-signup estimate is supported.
expected_behavior: Use the supplied audit and retrospective
Reject missing links as an established explanation
Identify signup readiness as a documented operational gap
Keep the number of missed subscriptions unquantified
hard_failures: Recommend adding links as the main diagnosis without addressing their increase
Ignore the retrospective because conversion attribution is incomplete

cases.task: Recommend social acquisition tactics using a competitor homepage and a founder case study reporting subscriber growth through LinkedIn. The requested channel is X.
expected_behavior: Explain the mechanism and reported result from the case study
Label application to X as a recommendation
Use homepage observations only for what they demonstrate
hard_failures: Treat homepage design as evidence of subscriber growth
Present LinkedIn results as measured X results
Forecast the same growth without supporting evidence
